name: Space
description: Where is the ISS right now, upcoming rocket launches with a reminder, and today's sunrise, sunset and moon phase. It uses your main place from Preferences, Places, or another place or a city you choose in Preferences, Space; your location never leaves your computer. ISS position: wheretheiss.at. Launch data: The Space Devs Launch Library 2. Sun and Moon are calculated offline.
author: Rafli
